_comment: Tool-agnostic MCP server definitions, written by chezmoi to ~/.config/mcp/mcp.json.
The one place the shared server set is declared. pi reads it through the
~/.pi/agent/mcp.json symlink; chezmoi's modify_ scripts merge it into Claude
Code's ~/.claude.json (minus context7, which the plugin provides) and Codex's
~/.codex/config.toml, and opencode.jsonc.tmpl renders opencode's mcp block from
it, so `chezmoi apply` after an edit reaches every harness.
Secrets never belong here: this repo is public. Remote servers authenticate
interactively (pi: /mcp or pi mcp login <name>; opencode: opencode mcp auth <name>).
description is pi-only: it lists the server in pi's system prompt and ranks its tools.
oauth.clientId: our *.mcp servers use Authelia as their authorization server, which has no
dynamic client registration, so each is a pre-registered public client named <server>-mcp.
oauth.callbackPort is pi's (127.0.0.1); the modify_ scripts give Claude Code 8766 (localhost,
which Authelia matches exactly) and Codex 8767 on 127.0.0.1 (lib/agent_settings.py).

paperless.description: Paperless-ngx document archive: search and read scanned documents and their metadata.

context7.description: Up-to-date library and API documentation for any package.

tabpfn.description: Prior Labs' TabPFN: classification and regression predictions on tabular data (CSV or inline rows) with no model training. Usage bills the connected Prior Labs account.

vercel.description: Vercel: search Vercel docs; inspect teams, projects, deployments, and build and runtime logs; query Web Analytics; deploy.

chrome-devtools.description: Drive and inspect the Chrome browser on port 5858: pages, DOM, console, network, performance.

chrome-live.description: Drive the user's own running Chrome (logged-in sessions). Needs remote debugging enabled at chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging; Chrome asks to allow each connection.
